title: #46 Worker Decision-Making
prompt: In some companies, employers involve workers in the decision-making process about products and services. What are the advantages and disadvantages of such a policy?

promptSegments.text: In some companies, employers involve workers in the decision-making process about products and services.
What are the advantages and disadvantages of such a policy?

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Worker ideas help improve product quality.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Worker ideas help improve product quality.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Workers feel valued and happier when they participate in decisions.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Workers feel valued and happier when they participate in decisions.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Worker ideas improve the product.

angles.en: Feeling respected helps the company grow.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Worker participation improves product quality.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Worker involvement strengthens internal relationships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Involving workers in decision-making gives them a sense of ownership, leading to greater care and improved product quality.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Involving workers in decision-making gives them a sense of ownership, leading to greater care and improved product quality.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: This approach enhances team spirit because staff feel valued when their opinions are sought, boosting motivation and morale.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: This approach enhances team spirit because staff feel valued when their opinions are sought, boosting motivation and morale.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not list advantages and disadvantages without making the required judgement.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ liệt kê ưu nhược điểm mà quên đưa ra nhận định bắt buộc.
